result.summary: A dark-themed AI coding assistant interface showing an open dropdown panel labeled 'Built-In Agents' positioned above a chat input box. The dropdown contains two rows: a selected 'Agent' option with a green icon and checkmark, and a 'Create Agent' option. The underlying input area includes a plus icon, 'Manual Approval' selector, '@ Agent' mention chip, model selector reading 'deepseek-v4.1-flash', a microphone icon, and a green send/up arrow button.
